topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: Rain's been drummin' on the city for days, like it's got a dirge to tell. Found this damn thing buried in the backyard, a time capsule. Figured it was a prank or a memory I’d rather keep lost. Popped it open, and all I got was a pile of old photos, a letter or two, and a couple of coins. The photos, they show people I can’t quite place, smiling, happy. The world's moved on without them. The letter’s from someone who signed off as 'an old friend,' talkin’ about a future that’s already past. Funny how things turn up when you least expect them, like old ghosts peekin’ through the fog. I reckon I’ll close this case, just like I close the door on the past, and let the rain wash it all away.
